name: small-range
description: Small range of head movement: about 8° of turn to each side, 6° up and 5° down.
notes: Turn 8° to the left and 8° to the right, up 6° and down 5°: all given. A turn of 10° or less is the small-range behaviour, the only behaviour on in this profile. Reach: at 1280×800 under the Default_Range (10° turn, 8° pitch), CALL and CAN'T BREATHE need 6.13° of turn and 5.12° up, and their confirms need 5.12° up with less turn (design.md, "Reachability of the urgent targets"). The plan's floor is 6.2° of turn each way and 5.2° up (TUNE). The given 8° and 6° meet it with 1.8° and 0.8° to spare, so both urgent targets and both confirms stay reachable. Down 5° has no floor, because no urgent target or confirm sits below the rest zone (SAF-7). Tremor 0° at 0 Hz: given, no tremor. Drift 0° per minute: given, no drift, so not the 0.5° default. Fatigue 0% per minute: given, no fatigue. Dozing null: given, no dozing. faceLost null: given, the face stays in view. Seed 3301: given for task 3.3. Every value comes from the description or the plan; all stay TUNE until there are volunteer recordings (tech.md).
